name: tcg-scanner
description: Browser-only trading card scanner: detects a card with the camera, reads its collector number and set code with OCR, and keeps an exportable list of scanned cards.

scripts.clean: node -e "for (const p of ['dist', 'public/tesseract', 'node_modules/.vite']) require('fs').rmSync(p, { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.clean:all: npm run clean && node -e "require('fs').rmSync('node_modules', { recursive: true, force: true })"
